title: Ijara va kommunal xizmatlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha ijara e’lonini o‘qib tushunasiz, uy ko‘rishda to‘g‘ri savollar berasiz, shartnoma shartlarini va kommunal to‘lovlarni aniqlaysiz, remont so‘raydigan xabar yozasiz hamda qo‘shnilar va uy qoidalari haqida gaplasha olasiz.
homework_uz: Landlordga remont haqida xabar yozing: nima buzilganini (boiler, kran, devordagi nam), qachon paydo bo‘lganini, qanday oqibatga olib kelayotganini va nimani so‘radingizligini aniq ko‘rsating; muammoning fotosini yoki videoni eslatib o‘ting. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: xabar inglizchada, muloyim ohangda, muammo + sana + so‘rov + dalil to‘rtlikni o‘z ichiga oladi va o‘qilganda bir daqiqadan oshmaydi. Keyingi dars: P1-14 Universitetga hujjat topshirish.

vocab.uz: ijara haqi — haftalik yoki oylik ('per week' / 'per calendar month')
qaytariladigan depozit — odatda bir-ikki oylik ijara
ijara shartnomasi — muddat, deposit, qoidalar yozilgan
uy egasi (erkak / ayol) — ularga xabar yozasiz
mol-mulk ro‘yxati — kirishda tekshiring va saqlang
nam / mog‘or / oqish — eng ko‘p uchraydigan uch muammo
elektr, suv yoki gaz hisoblagichi ko‘rsatkichi
uy qoidalari — shovqin, chekish, hayvonlar, mehmonlar

scenes.title: Ijara darsiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda bank va hujjatlar bilan ishladik — hisob ochish, kartalar, formalar va muddatlar. Bugun esa uy-joy: ijara e’lonini o‘qish, uy ko‘rishda savol berish, shartnoma shartlari, remont so‘rash, qo‘shnilar va uy qoidalari. Dars oxirida siz inglizcha kvartira ijaraga olasiz va uy muammolarini hal qilasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson was banking and paperwork. Today: renting — reading a rental ad, viewing a flat, understanding the contract and the bills, reporting repairs, and dealing with neighbours and house rules. By the end, you'll rent a flat in English.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda bank va hujjatlarni o‘rgandik. Bugun: ijara — e’lonni o‘qish, uy ko‘rish, shartnoma va kommunal to‘lovlar, remont so‘rash, qo‘shnilar va qoidalar. Dars oxirida kvartira ijaraga olasiz.

scenes.title: Ijara inglizchasining 4 hududi
scenes.say_native: Ijara mavzusi to‘rt hududga bo‘linadi. Bir: e’lon — narx, joylashuv, nima kiradi; bunga 'per calendar month' kabi qisqartmalar ham kiradi. Ikki: uy ko‘rish va shartnoma — deposits, notice period, inventory. Uch: remont — buzilgan narsalarni qanday va kimga xabar qilish. To‘rt: qo‘shnilar va qoidalar — shovqin, hayvonlar, chekish, mehmonlar. Shu to‘rttasini ishlaymiz.
scenes.say: Renting has four areas. One: the ad — price, location, what's included, including abbreviations like pcm. Two: viewing and the contract — deposits, notice period, inventory. Three: repairs — who to tell and how. Four: neighbours and house rules — noise, pets, smoking, guests.
scenes.say_uz: Ijara to‘rt hududga bo‘linadi. Bir: e’lon — narx, joylashuv, nimalar kiradi va pcm kabi qisqartmalar. Ikki: viewing va shartnoma — deposit, notice period, inventory. Uch: remont — kimga, qanday xabar qilish. To‘rt: qo‘shnilar va qoidalar — shovqin, hayvonlar, chekish, mehmonlar.

scenes.title: Ijara e’lonini o‘qish

examples.t: Rent 800 dollars pcm, deposit one month, bills included.
examples.uz: Ijara oyiga 800 dollar, depozit bir oylik, kommunal to‘lovlar kiritilgan.

scenes.say_native: E’londagi har bir so‘z ma’lumot. 'Rent 800 pcm' — oyiga 800; 'pw' — haftasiga. 'Deposit: one month' — qaytariladigan depozit bir oylik. 'Bills included' — kommunal to‘lovlar ijaraga kiritilgan, kiritilmagan bo‘lsa — alohida to‘laysiz. 'Furnished' — mebellangan; 'unfurnished' — bo‘sh. 'Available from 1 June' — qachondan bo‘sh. Narxni yillik o‘ylamang: haftalik narxni 4.33 ga ko‘paytirib oylikka aylantiring.
scenes.say: Every word in an ad matters. 'Rent 800 pcm' — per calendar month; 'pw' — per week. 'Deposit: one month' — refundable, usually one or two months' rent. 'Bills included' — utilities come with the rent; otherwise you pay them separately. 'Furnished' or 'unfurnished'. 'Available from 1 June' — when you can move in.
scenes.say_uz: E’londagi har so‘z ma’lumot. 'Rent 800 pcm' — oyiga; 'pw' — haftasiga. 'Deposit: one month' — qaytariladi, odatda bir-ikki oylik. 'Bills included' — kommunallar kiradi; aks holda alohida. 'Furnished / unfurnished'. 'Available from 1 June' — qachondan bo‘sh.

scenes.title: Qisqartmalar: pcm, pw, o‘rinlar

examples.uz: Yorug‘ studiya, haftasiga 120, depozit ikki haftalik.

scenes.say_native: Qisqartmalarni o‘rganing: pcm — per calendar month, oylik; pw — per week, haftalik; pw 120 degani, oyiga taxminan 520. 'Studio' — bir xona-oshxona birga; '1-bed' yoki '1-bedroom' — bir yotoqxona; '2-bed' — ikki yotoqxona. 'Incl.' — included, kiritilgan; 'excl.' — excluded, kiritilmagan. 'DSS' yoki 'no DSS' — ba’zi e’lonlarda yordam oluvchilar uchun cheklov; buni ham ko‘rib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Learn the abbreviations: pcm — per calendar month; pw — per week, so 120 pw is roughly 520 a month. 'Studio' — one room with a kitchen corner. '1-bed' — one bedroom. 'Incl.' — included; 'excl.' — not included. And some ads carry restrictions like 'no DSS' — know what you're looking at.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqartmalar: pcm — oyiga; pw — haftasiga, pw 120 ≈ oyiga 520. 'Studio' — bir xona-oshxona. '1-bed' — bir yotoqxona. 'Incl.' — kiradi; 'excl.' — kirmaydi. Ba’zi e’lonlarda 'no DSS' kabi cheklovlar ham bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Namuna: e’lon va tahlili
scenes.say_native: Namuna e’lonni o‘qing va tahlil qiling: narx oylikmi yoki haftalik (pcm/pw)? Depozit qancha va u qaytariladimi? Kommunallar — bills included — kiradi yoki yo‘q? Mebellanganmi? Qachondan bo‘sh va shartnoma kamida necha oy? Shu olti savol har bir e’lon uchun birinchi qadam.
scenes.say: Bright one-bed flat, city centre. Rent 750 pcm, deposit one month, bills NOT included. Furnished, available 1 July, minimum tenancy 6 months. No pets. Contact agent, viewings Saturday. — Reading it: 750 per month, one-month refundable deposit, you pay gas, electricity, water and internet separately, furniture included, from 1 July, at least six months' contract, no animals.
scenes.say_uz: Yorug‘ bir yotoqxona xonali kvartira, shahar markazida. Ijara oyiga 750, depozit bir oylik, kommunallar KIRITILMAGAN. Mebellangan, 1-iyuldan bo‘sh, kamida 6 oylik shartnoma. Hayvonlar yo‘q. Agentga murojaat qiling, viewing shanba kuni. — Tahlili: oyiga 750, bir oylik qaytariladigan depozit, kommunallarni alohida to‘laysiz, mebellangan, 1-iyuldan, kamida olti oy, hayvonlar taqiqlangan.

scenes.title: Viewing: uy ko‘rish savollari
board: 'Is it per week or per month?'

examples.t: How much is the deposit, and is it protected?

scenes.say_native: Uy ko‘rishda oldindan oltita savol tayyorlang: bir — 'Is the rent per week or per calendar month?'; ikki — 'How much is the deposit and is it protected?' — depozit himoyalanganmi; uch — 'What's the notice period?' — muddat; to‘rt — 'Are bills included?' — kommunallar; besh — 'Is it furnished?' — mebellanganmi; olti — 'When can I move in?' — qachon kirish mumkin. Uy ichida: devorlarga nam, kranlarga oqish, rozetkalarga nosozlik bormi — tekshiring va suratga oling.
scenes.say: Prepare six questions for a viewing: 'Is the rent per week or per calendar month?' 'How much is the deposit, and is it protected?' 'What's the notice period?' 'Are bills included?' 'Is it furnished?' 'When can I move in?' Inside: check for damp, leaks, faulty sockets — and take photos.
scenes.say_uz: Viewing uchun olti savol: 'Per week or per calendar month?' 'Deposit qancha va protectedmi?' 'Notice period?' 'Bills included?' 'Furnished?' 'When can I move in?' Uy ichida: nam, oqish, rozetkalarni tekshiring — va suratga oling.

scenes.title: Namuna: uy ko‘rish dialogi
scenes.say_native: Namuna viewing dialogini o‘qing: mijoz e’londagi barcha raqamlarni — narx, depozit, kommunallar, notice period va kirish sanasi — aniqlashtiradi, agent har biriga aniq javob beradi. E’tibor bering — mijoz hech narsani taxmin qilmaydi va suhbat oxirida suratga olishga ruxsat so‘raydi; bu keyingi tortishuvlarning oldini oladi.
scenes.say: Hello — I called about the one-bed flat. Of course. Come in. Is the rent per week or per month? Per calendar month — seven hundred and fifty. And the deposit? One month, and it's protected in a deposit scheme. Are bills included? No — gas, electricity, water and internet are separate. Notice period? One month. Is it furnished? Fully — bed, sofa, wardrobe, washing machine. When can I move in? First of July. Could I take photos of the rooms? Of course, please do.
scenes.say_uz: Salom — bir yotoqxona kvartira bo‘yicha qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan edim. Albatta, kiring. Ijara haftalikmi yoki oylik? Oylik — yetti yuz ellik. Depozit? Bir oylik va deposit schemeda himoyalangan. Kommunallar kiradi? Yo‘q — gaz, elektr, suv va internet alohida. Ogohlantirish muddati? Bir oy. Mebellanganmi? To‘liq — karavot, divan, shkaf, kir yuvish mashinasi. Qachon kirsam bo‘ladi? Birinchi iyulda. Xonalarni suratga olsam maylimi? Albatta, bemalol.

scenes.title: Viewing savollarini ayting
scenes.say_native: Uy ko‘rishdagi olti savolni ovoz chiqarib, navbat bilan va tabiiy ohangda so‘rang: narx formati — haftalikmi yoki oylik, depozit miqdori va uning himoyasi, notice period, kommunallar, mebellanganmi va kirish sanasi. Har birini alohida — yigirma soniyada.
scenes.say: Ask the six viewing questions aloud: rent format, deposit and its protection, notice period, bills, furnished, move-in date. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Viewingning olti savolini ovoz chiqarib so‘rang: narx formati, depozit va uning himoyasi, notice period, kommunallar, mebel, kirish sanasi. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Tenancy agreement: shartnoma shartlari

examples.t: The agreement is for twelve months, rent due on the 1st.
examples.uz: Shartnoma o‘n ikki oyga, ijara har oyning 1-sanasida to‘lanadi.

scenes.say_native: Tenancy agreement — ijara shartnomasi, har bir so‘zi muhim. O‘qishda to‘rt narsani toping: bir — muddat: 'twelve months' yoki 'six months'; ikki — ijaraning oylik kuni: 'rent due on the 1st'; uch — depozit himoyasi: qaysi sxemada; to‘rt — qoidalar: shovqin, chekish, hayvonlar. Imzolashdan oldin har bir qatorni o‘qing; tushunmagan qatorni so‘rang — 'Could you explain this clause?' Shartnoma imzolanganidan keyin 'bilmadim' ishlamaydi.
scenes.say: The tenancy agreement matters line by line. Find four things: length — six or twelve months; the rent due date — 'rent due on the 1st'; deposit protection — which scheme holds it; the rules — noise, smoking, pets. Read every clause before signing; ask 'Could you explain this clause?' — after signing, 'I didn't know' doesn't help.
scenes.say_uz: Tenancy agreement matniga qatorma-qator qarang. To‘rt narsa toping: muddat — olti yoki o‘n ikki oy; to‘lov kuni — 'rent due on the 1st'; depozit himoyasi — qaysi sxema; qoidalar — shovqin, chekish, hayvonlar. Imzolashdan oldin har qatorni o‘qing: 'Could you explain this clause?' — keyin 'bilmadim' ishlamaydi.

scenes.title: Deposit: himoya va qaytarish

examples.t: Is my deposit protected in a government scheme?

scenes.say_native: Depozit — uy egasi uchun kafolat emas, sizning pulingiz. Ko‘p davlatlarda depozit 'deposit protection scheme' — davlat sxemasida saqlanishi shart; uy egasi uni o‘z hisobida ushlab turishi kerak emas. Kirishda inventory ro‘yxatini o‘qing va har bir xonani suratga oling — devordagi nuqson, eski mebel, derazadagi tirnalish. Chiqishda aynan shu holatda topshiring — depozit to‘liq qaytadi; kamchilik bo‘lsa — yozma bayonnoma bilan.
scenes.say: The deposit is your money, held as security. In many countries it must sit in a government-approved deposit protection scheme. On day one: read the inventory, photograph every room and every flaw. When you move out, leave it in the same state — the full deposit comes back; if not, you get a detailed deduction list.
scenes.say_uz: Depozit — sizning pulingiz, kafolat sifatida saqlanadi. Ko‘p davlatlarda davlat sxemasida saqlanishi shart. Birinchi kunda: inventory o‘qing, har xona va har nuqsonni suratga oling. Chiqishda aynan shu holatda topshiring — depozit to‘liq qaytadi.

scenes.title: Kommunallar: kim to‘laydi

examples.t: Who pays for gas and electricity — me or the landlord?
examples.uz: Gaz va elektrik uchun kim to‘laydi — men yoki uy egasimi?

scenes.say_native: Kommunal to‘lovlar besh qismdan iborat: gas — gaz, electricity — elektr, water — suv, internet — internet, council tax — mahalliy soliq (UKda). E’londa 'bills included' bo‘lsa — hammasi ijara narxida. Aks holda har birini alohida hisobga o‘tkazishingiz kerak — ko‘chishdan oldin gaz va elektr hisoblagich ko‘rsatkichlarini suratga oling: 'meter reading'. Yetib kelganbirinchi va oxirgi to‘lovlarda tortishuv chiqmasligi uchun bu eng muhim qadam.
scenes.say: Five bills to track: gas, electricity, water, internet, council tax (UK). 'Bills included' means they're all inside the rent. Otherwise you set up each account yourself. On day one, photograph the gas and electricity meters — 'meter reading' — so your first and last bills are never disputed.
scenes.say_uz: Besh kommunal: gas, electricity, water, internet, council tax (UK). 'Bills included' — hammasi ijarada. Aks holda har birini alohida rasmiylashtiring. Birinchi kunda gaz va elektr hisoblagichni suratga oling — birinchi va oxirgi to‘lovlar bahssiz bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: viewing — raqamlarni aniqlash
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — uy ko‘rish kuni. Adolat agent bilan ijara shartlari va kommunallar haqida gaplashmoqda: narx, depozit himoyasi, qaysi kommunallar kiradi va kirish kuni hisoblagich ko‘rsatkichlari birga olinadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — keyingi sahifada to‘rt savol bor.
scenes.say: Agent: Welcome. As you saw, bright one-bed, 750 pcm. Adolat: And the deposit? Agent: One month, protected in the national scheme. Adolat: Are the bills included? Agent: Gas and water, yes — electricity and internet are yours. Adolat: What about the internet then? About twenty-five a month. Agent: Perfect. Notice period? One month. How long is the agreement? Twelve months. Adolat: I'll take it. When can I move in? First of August, and I'll do the meter readings with you.
scenes.say_uz: Agent: Marhamat. Ko‘rganingizday, yorug‘ bir yotoqxona kvartira, oyiga 750. Adolat: Depozit? Agent: Bir oylik, milliy sxemada himoyalangan. Adolat: Kommunallar kiradi? Agent: Gaz va suv, ha — elektr va internet sizniki. Adolat: Internet qancha? Oyiga yigirma besh atrofida. Agent: Ajoyib. Notice period? Bir oy. Shartnoma necha oy? O‘n ikki oy. Adolat: Olardim. Qachon kirsam bo‘ladi? Birinchi avgustda — kirish kuni hisoblagichni birga ko‘ramiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: ijara qancha va depozit qancha? Ikki: qaysi kommunallar ijaraga kiradi, qaysilarini Adolat to‘laydi? Uch: shartnoma muddati va ogohlantirish muddati qancha? To‘rt: Adolat qachon ko‘chib kiradi va kirish kuni nima qiladi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what is the rent and the deposit? Two: which bills are included, and which does Adolat pay? Three: how long is the agreement and what's the notice period? Four: when does she move in — and what will they do together on that day? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: ijara va depozit qancha? Ikki: qaysi kommunallar kiradi, qaysilarini to‘laydi? Uch: muddat va notice period qancha? To‘rt: qachon ko‘chib kiradi va o‘sha kuni nima qilishadi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
board: 2. Gaz + suv kiradi; elektr + internet Adolatniki
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: ijara oyiga yetti yuz ellik, depozit bir oylik — va depozit milliy sxemada himoyalangan. Ikki: gaz va suv ijaraga kiritilgan; elektr va internetni Adolat o‘zi to‘laydi — internet taxminan yigirma besh atrofida. Uch: shartnoma o‘n ikki oylik, ogohlantirish muddati bir oy. To‘rt: birinchi avgustda ko‘chib kiradi va o‘sha kuni agent bilan hisoblagich ko‘rsatkichlarini birga ko‘rib suratga olishadi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: 750 per month, one month's deposit, protected in the national scheme. Two: gas and water included; electricity and internet are hers — about twenty-five a month for the internet. Three: twelve months' agreement, one month's notice. Four: she moves in on the 1st of August, and they'll do the meter readings together.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: 750 oyiga, depozit bir oylik, himoyalangan. Ikki: gaz va suv kiradi; elektr va internet — o‘zi, internet ~25. Uch: o‘n ikki oy, bir oylik notice. To‘rt: 1-avgust, hisoblagich ko‘rsatkichlari birga.

scenes.title: Remont: uy egasi va sizning vazifalaringiz

examples.t: The boiler is broken — there's no hot water since yesterday.
examples.uz: Boiler buzildi — kemadan beri issiq suv yo‘q.

scenes.say_native: Ta’mirlashda odatda shu taqsimot ishlaydi: uy egasi — boiler va isitish, tom, tashqi devorlar, elektr simlari va trubalar; ijara beruvchi — lampalar, eshik tugmalari, kichik ta’mirlashlar. Mahalliy qonun farq qilishi mumkin, shuning uchun shartnomani tekshiring. Xabar inglizchasi: 'The boiler is broken' — boiler buzildi; 'There's no hot water' — issiq suv yo‘q; 'There's a leak under the sink' — kran ostida oqish bor. Xabarga sana, joy va ta’sirini qo‘shing — tez reaksiya keladi.
scenes.say: Typical split: the landlord handles the boiler and heating, the roof, outside walls, wiring and pipes; the tenant handles light bulbs and minor fixes. Local laws vary — check your contract. Phrases: 'The boiler is broken.' 'There's no hot water.' 'There's a leak under the sink.' Add date, place and effect — you'll get a faster response.
scenes.say_uz: Odatiy taqsimot: uy egasi — boiler, isitish, tom, tashqi devorlar, simlar va trubalar; siz — lampalar va mayda narsalar. Qonunlar farq qiladi — shartnomani tekshiring. Iboralar: 'The boiler is broken.' 'There's no hot water.' 'There's a leak under the sink.' Sana, joy va ta’sirini qo‘shing — tez javob keladi.

scenes.title: Repair lug‘ati: leak, damp, mould

examples.t: There's damp on the bedroom wall and black mould in the corner.
examples.uz: Yotoqxona devorida nam va burchakda qora mog‘or bor.

scenes.say_native: Remont lug‘atini yodlang: leak — oqish ('a leak under the sink'); damp — nam ('damp patches on the ceiling'); mould — mog‘or ('black mould in the corner'); blockage — tiqilish ('the drain is blocked'); faulty socket — buzuq rozetka ('this socket doesn't work'); cracked window — yorilgan oyna; boiler — boiler; fuse box — eletrik quti. Aniq so‘z — tez yechim: 'There's damp on the bedroom wall' uy egasiga sizning shikoyatingiz jiddiy ekanligini darhol bildiradi.
scenes.say: Repair vocabulary: a leak under the sink; damp patches on the ceiling; black mould in the corner; the drain is blocked; this socket doesn't work; a cracked window; the boiler; the fuse box. The precise word brings the fast fix — 'damp on the bedroom wall' tells the landlord this is serious.
scenes.say_uz: Remont lug‘ati: leak under the sink; damp patches on the ceiling; black mould in the corner; the drain is blocked; this socket doesn't work; cracked window; boiler; fuse box. Aniq so‘z — tez yechim; 'damp on the bedroom wall' shikoyat jiddiyligini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Repair xabarini ayting
scenes.say_native: Landlordga remont xabarini ovoz chiqarib ayting. Vaziyat: oshxona kran ostidan kechasi suv oqyapti — devorga tushmoqda; kemadan beri davom etmoqda. Nima buzildi, qayerda, qachon boshlandi va nimaning ta’siriga — buni bir nafasda inglizchada ayting. Yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Speak the repair message. Scenario: a leak under the kitchen sink, dripping onto the wall, going on since last night. Say what's broken, where, since when and the effect — in one breath, in English. Twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Repair xabarini ayting. Oshxona kran ostidan suv oqmoqda, devorga tushyapti, kemadan beri. Nima buzildi, qayerda, qachon boshlandi, oqibati — bir nafasda inglizchada. Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Namuna: landlordga yozma xabar
scenes.say_native: Namuna landlordga yozilgan xabarni o‘qing va tuzilmasini ajrating: muammo bir jumlada, joyi va sanasi, ta’siri — devorga va polga tushayotgani, aniq so‘rov — plumber va vaqt. Oxirida foto ilova qilish taklifi va payshanba kuni uyda bo‘lish ma’lumoti bor — bunday xabarga uy egasi o‘sha kuni javob beradi.
scenes.say: Hi Mr Saidov, I'm writing about the kitchen sink. There has been a slow leak underneath since last night — water is reaching the wall and the floor next to the cupboard. I've placed a bucket under it and taken photos, which I can send over. Could you arrange a plumber as soon as possible — ideally tomorrow morning? I'm home all day on Thursday. Kind regards, Azamat.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Saidov aka, oshxona kran ostidagi oqish haqida yozyapman. Kemadan beri sekin suv oqadi — suv devorga va shkaf yonidagi polga tushmoqda. Tagiga chelak qo‘ydim va foto olganman — yuborib berishim mumkin. Iloji bo‘lsa, ertaga ertalab plumber yubora olasizmi? Payshanba kuni kun bo‘yi uydaman. Hurmat bilan, Azamat.

scenes.title: Kirish kuni: inventory va hisoblagich

examples.t: Shall we do the meter readings together?

scenes.say_native: Kirish kunida uch qadam. Bir: inventory — mol-mulk ro‘yxati — o‘qing va har bir nuqsonni foto qiling; imzolaganingiz inventoryda ko‘rsatilgan holatni tan olganingiz demakdir. Ikki: hisoblagich ko‘rsatkichlari — gaz, elektr va suv — suratga oling va sana bilan saqlang. Uch: kalitlar ro‘yxati — qancha kalit oldingiz, qayerdan. Bu uch qadam chiqish kuni deposit tortishuvining oldini oladi.
scenes.say: Move-in day, three steps. One: read the inventory and photograph every flaw — signing it means you accept the listed condition. Two: photograph the gas, electricity and water meters with the date. Three: count the keys you receive. These three steps prevent every deposit dispute on day out.
scenes.say_uz: Kirish kuni uch qadam. Bir: inventory o‘qing, har nuqsonni suratga oling — imzolashingiz — holatni tan olishingiz. Ikki: gaz, elektr, suv hisoblagichlarini sana bilan suratga oling. Uch: kalitlarni sanang. Bu uch qadam deposit bahslarini yo‘q qiladi.

scenes.title: Ko‘chish: ogohlantirish muddati

examples.t: I'm giving 30 days' notice — my last day will be 31 July.
examples.uz: 30 kun oldindan ogohlantiraman — oxirgi kunim 31-iyul bo‘ladi.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘chish ham inglizcha: 'I'm giving 30 days' notice' — o‘ttiz kun oldin ogohlantiraman. Muddat shartnomaga qarab o‘zgaradi — bir oy yoki ikki oy. Ogohlantirishni har doim yozma yuboring: email yoki xat — sana bilan. Chiqishdan oldin so‘rang: deposit qachon va qanday qaytariladi — 'When will the deposit be returned?' Uy egasi depozitni kech qaytarsa, himoya sxemasiga ariza topshirishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: Moving out is English too: 'I'm giving 30 days' notice.' The period depends on the contract — often one or two months. Always give notice in writing — email or letter, dated. And ask: 'When will the deposit be returned?' If it doesn't come back, you can raise a dispute with the deposit scheme.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘chish ham inglizcha: 'I'm giving 30 days' notice.' Muddat shartnomaga bog‘liq — ko‘pincha bir-ikki oy. Ogohlantirishni yozma bering — sana bilan. So‘rang: 'When will the deposit be returned?' Qaytmasa — himoya sxemasiga ariza.

scenes.title: Qo‘shnilar va uy qoidalari

examples.t: The neighbours play music loudly after midnight.
examples.uz: Qo‘shnilar yarim tundan keyin musiqani baland o‘ynashadi.

scenes.say_native: Qo‘shnilar bilan muammo uch bosqichda hal bo‘ladi. Bir: to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri va muloyim gapiring — 'Hi, the music is a bit loud late at night — could you keep it down after 11?' Ko‘p odam bilmaydi va uzr so‘raydi. Ikki: yordam bermasa — uy egasiga yozma xabar bering, sana va vaqtlarini yozib. Uch: davom etsa — mahalliy idoraga ariza. Uy qoidalariga kelsak: aksariyat shartnomalarda shovqin soati (odatda 23:00 dan keyin), chekish taqiqi va hayvonlar qoidalari belgilangan — imzolaringizdan oldin ularni o‘qing.
scenes.say: Neighbour problems, three stages. One: speak to them directly and politely — 'Hi, the music is a bit loud late at night — could you keep it down after eleven?' Many didn't realise. Two: no luck — put it in writing to the landlord with dates and times. Three: still continuing — a complaint to the local council. House rules cover quiet hours, smoking and pets — read them before signing.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘shnilar uch bosqichda: bir — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri, muloyim: 'Hi, the music is a bit loud late at night — could you keep it down after eleven?' Ikki — natija yo‘q: uy egasiga yozma, sana va vaqtlar bilan. Uch — davom etsa: mahalliy idoraga. House rules — shovqin soati, chekish, hayvonlar: imzolashdan oldin o‘qing.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: shovqin va remont bir hafta
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — Sherzodning ikki muammosi bir xatda: shovqinli qo‘shni va oshxona kranining oqishi. U uy egasiga xabar yozadi va ikkala muammo uchun ham aniq so‘rov qoldiradi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — har ikki muammoni qanday qilib bitta xabarga joylayapti.
scenes.say: Sherzod: Two things, Mrs Karimova. First, the flat above plays music loudly until two most nights — it wakes the baby. Could you remind them of the quiet hours? Second, the kitchen tap has been leaking since Sunday — water under the sink every morning. I wiped it and took photos. Could you send a plumber? I'm home tomorrow and Friday. Mrs Karimova: Sorry — I'll call the upstairs tenant today, and the plumber tomorrow morning. Sherzod: Please text me when he's confirmed.
scenes.say_uz: Sherzod: Salom, Karimova opa — ikki narsa. Birinchidan, yuqoridagi kvartirada yarim tungacha musiqa baland, deyarli har kecha. Bolani uyg‘otadi. Uy qoidalaridagi shovqin soatlari haqida ularga ayta olasizmi? Ikkinchidan, oshxona krani yakshanbadan beri oqmoqda — har ertalab kran ostida suv. Artdim va foto olganman. Plumber yubora olasizmi? Ertaga va juma kuni uydaman. Karimova opa: Uzr — bugun yuqoridagi ijarachi bilan gaplashaman, plumberni ertaga ertalab yuboraman. Sherzod: Rahmat — tasdiqlagandan keyin SMS yozing.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
board: 3 Uy egasi nima qilishga va’da berdi?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Sherzodning birinchi muammosi nima va kimga xabar berdi? Ikki: ikkinchi muammo nima va qachondan beri davom etmoqda? Uch: uy egasi ikkala muammo bo‘yicha nima qilishga va’da berdi? To‘rt: Sherzod qanday tasdiqni so‘radi — nima uchun? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what is Sherzod's first problem, and who is he telling? Two: what is the second problem, and since when? Three: what did the landlady promise to do about both? Four: what confirmation did he ask for — and why? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: birinchi muammo nima, kimga aytdi? Ikki: ikkinchi muammo va qachondan? Uch: uy egasi nima va’da berdi? To‘rt: qanday tasdiq so‘radi — nega? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: yuqoridagi kvartira yarim tungacha baland musiqa eshitadi — Sherzod uy egasidan house rulesdagi shovqin soatlarini eslatishni so‘radi. Ikki: oshxona krani — yakshanbadan beri oqmoqda. Uch: uy egasi ijara beruvchi bilan o‘sha kuni gaplashishga va plumberni ertaga ertalab yuborishga va’da berdi. To‘rt: Sherzod SMS tasdig‘ini so‘radi — plumber kelganini aniq bilish va kun bo‘yi kutib o‘tirmaslik uchun.
scenes.say: Answers. One: the upstairs neighbour plays loud music until two in the morning — he asked the landlady to remind them of the quiet hours. Two: a kitchen tap leak, ongoing since Sunday. Three: she'll speak to the tenant today and send a plumber tomorrow morning. Four: an SMS confirmation — so he knows the plumber is booked and doesn't wait all day.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: yuqoridagi shovqin — house rules eslatilsin. Ikki: oshxona krani — yakshanbadan. Uch: qo‘shni bilan gaplashish + plumber ertaga. To‘rt: SMS tasdiq — rejani bilish uchun.

scenes.title: Email yozish: muammo → sana → so‘rov

examples.t: Subject: Repair needed — kitchen tap leak since Sunday.
examples.uz: Mavzu: Remont kerak — yakshanbadan beri oshxona krani oqmoqda.

scenes.say_native: Landlordga email uch qismdan iborat: bir — muammo bir jumlada; ikki — qachondan beri va ta’siri; uch — aniq so‘rov: plumber, vaqt va aloqa. Mavzu satrini aniq yozing: 'Repair needed — kitchen tap leak since Sunday'. Ilovaga foto qo‘shing va qachon uyda bo‘lishingizni ayting. Muloyimlik — kuch: 'Could you arrange a plumber?' har doim 'Send someone NOW' dan tezroq ishlaydi.
scenes.say: A landlord email has three parts: the problem in one line; since when and its effect; a clear request — plumber, time and contact. Subject line: 'Repair needed — kitchen tap leak since Sunday'. Attach photos, state when you're home, stay polite — 'Could you arrange a plumber?' beats outrage every time.
scenes.say_uz: Landlord emaili uch qism: muammo bir jumlada; qachondan va oqibati; aniq so‘rov — plumber, vaqt, aloqa. Mavzu: 'Repair needed — kitchen tap leak since Sunday'. Foto ilova qiling, qachon uyda ekaningizni ayting, muloyim bo‘ling — 'Could you arrange a plumber?' eng tez ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: rent, lease, deposit

examples.t: The deposit is two months' rent.

scenes.say_native: To‘rt so‘zning talaffuzi. 'Rent' — 'RENT', bir bo‘g‘in. 'Lease' — 'LEES', uzun i bilan. 'Deposit' — 'di-PO-zit', stress o‘rtada. 'Neighbour' — 'NAY-ba', oxiridagi 'gh' jim; 'neighbor' AQSh yozilishi. 'Tenancy' — 'TE-nan-si'. Ijara suhbatlarida bu so‘zlar har kuni uchraydi — sekin va aniq talaffuz qiling.
scenes.say: Four pronunciations. 'Rent' — 'RENT', one syllable. 'Lease' — 'LEES', long e. 'Deposit' — 'di-PO-zit', stress in the middle. 'Neighbour' — 'NAY-ba', the gh is silent; 'neighbor' is the US spelling. 'Tenancy' — 'TE-nan-si'. Say these slowly — they appear in every rental conversation.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt talaffuz. 'Rent' — 'RENT'. 'Lease' — 'LEES'. 'Deposit' — 'di-PO-zit'. 'Neighbour' — 'NAY-ba', gh jim; AQShda 'neighbor'. 'Tenancy' — 'TE-nan-si'. Sekin va aniq ayting — har ijara suhbatida kerak.

scenes.title: 6 tipik xato: ijara inglizchasida
board: 4 'I pay the rent of the flat' — rent for
scenes.say_native: Olti xato. Bir: 'I rent a flat since 2020' xato — since bilan present perfect: 'I've rented a flat since 2020'. Ikki: 'landlord woman' demang — 'landlady'. Uch: 'my neighbour make noise' — uchinchi shaxsga -s: 'makes noise'. To‘rt: 'rent of the flat' emas — 'rent for the flat'. Besh: 'deposit for the flat' to‘g‘ri, lekin 'is big' emas — 'is high'. Oltinchi: 'repairment' degan so‘z yo‘q — 'repair'.
scenes.say: Six fixes. 'Since 2020' needs the present perfect: 'I've rented a flat since 2020.' A female owner is a 'landlady'. 'My neighbour makes noise.' 'Rent for the flat', not 'of'. A deposit is 'high', not 'big'. And the word is 'repair' — 'repairment' doesn't exist.
scenes.say_uz: Olti tuzatish. Since — present perfect: 'I've rented since 2020.' Ayol uy egasi — 'landlady'. 'My neighbour makes noise.' 'Rent for the flat'. Depozit 'high', 'big' emas. 'Repairment' yo‘q — 'repair'.

scenes.title: Xato → To‘g‘ri: zamon va so‘z tartibi
scenes.say_native: Ikki asosiy xato. Bir — since bilan present perfect: o‘tgan va hozir davom etayotgan harakat 'have/has + V3' talab qiladi: 'I've lived here since March'; oddiy o‘tgan zamon emas. Ikki — uchinchi shaxs -s: 'the neighbour makes a noise'; 'he make' — xato, chunki o‘zbekcha 'qiladi' da -s alomat yo‘q, lekin inglizchada -s majburiy.
scenes.say: Two core errors. 'Since' pairs only with the present perfect: 'I've lived here since March.' Never with the simple past. And third-person singular needs -s: 'the neighbour makes a noise' — Uzbek gives no signal, English always requires it.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki asosiy xato. 'Since' present perfect bilan: 'I've lived here since March' — oddiy o‘tgan zamon emas. Uchinchi shaxs -s majburiy: 'the neighbour makes a noise'.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoni inglizchaga to‘g‘rilang: 'I live here since June' — 'I've lived here since June'. 'Neighbour make noise' — 'the neighbour makes noise'. 'Landlord woman' — 'landlady'. Har birini ovoz chiqarib, to‘g‘ri shaklda ayting — yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Fix three: 'I live here since June' — 'I've lived here since June.' 'Neighbour make noise' — 'the neighbour makes noise.' 'Landlord woman' — 'landlady.' Aloud, twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Uchtasini tuzating: 'I live here since June' — 'I've lived here since June.' 'Neighbour make noise' — 'the neighbour makes noise.' 'Landlord woman' — 'landlady.' Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Viewing dialogini o‘ynang
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq viewing dialogini o‘ynang. Vaziyat: bir yotoqxona kvartirani ko‘rishga keldingiz — e’londa 750 pcm deyilgan. Uy egasidan narx formatini, depozitni va uning himoyasini, kommunallarni, notice periodni va kirish sanasini so‘rang; oxirida 'I'd like to take it' yoki 'I'll think about it' deb yakunlang. O‘ttiz besh soniya.
scenes.say: Act out the full viewing. You're viewing a one-bed flat advertised at 750 pcm: ask about the rent format, the deposit and its protection, the bills, the notice period and the move-in date. Finish with 'I'd like to take it' or 'I'll think about it.' Thirty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq viewingni o‘ynang. 750 pcm e’lon qilingan bir yotoqxona kvartirani ko‘rasiz: narx formati, depozit va himoyasi, kommunallar, notice period va kirish sanasini so‘rang. 'I'd like to take it' yoki 'I'll think about it' bilan tugating. O‘ttiz besh soniya.

scenes.title: Muammoni hal qilish: muammo, joy, dalil

examples.t: Two days of damp on the bedroom wall — photos attached.
examples.uz: Yotoqxona devorida ikki kunlik nam — foto ilova qilindi.

scenes.say_native: Uy muammosini xabar qilishning uch qadami: bir — muammo va joyni aniq ayting: 'damp on the bedroom wall'; ikki — qachondan beri va ta’sirini: 'since Sunday, the bedroom smells'; uch — dalil: foto yoki video. Uchala qadam bir xatda bo‘lsa, uy egasi darhol harakat qiladi. 'It's bad' kabi mavhum xabarlarga hech kim shoshilmaydi — aniqlik tezligingizni belgilaydi.
scenes.say: Report a housing problem in three steps: one — name the problem and place, like 'damp on the bedroom wall'; two — since when and its effect; three — evidence, photos or video. Three facts in one message get the fastest action — vague 'it's bad' gets a slow reply.
scenes.say_uz: Uy muammosini uch qadamda: bir — muammo va joy: 'damp on the bedroom wall'; ikki — qachondan va ta’siri; uch — dalil: foto yoki video. Uch fakt — eng tez javob; mavhum 'it's bad' — sekin javob.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa: e’londa pcm yoki pw, depozit va bills included yoki yo‘qligini tekshiring. Viewingda olti savol — narx, depozit, kommunallar, notice, mebel, sana — va har doim foto oling. Shartnomada muddat, to‘lov kuni va deposit protectionni toping. Repair xabarida muammo, sana va foto bo‘lsin. Qo‘shni muammosini muloyim gap bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: In short: check pcm vs pw, deposit, bills in the ad. At the viewing, six questions — price, deposit, bills, notice, furniture, date — and always take photos. In the contract, find the length, due date and deposit protection. Repair messages carry the problem, the date and the photo. Neighbours — polite words first.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: e’londa pcm/pw, depozit, bills included. Viewingda olti savol — va foto. Shartnomada muddat, sana, deposit protection. Repair xabari: muammo + sana + foto. Qo‘shni — avval muloyim so‘z.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Uy vazifasi: landlordga remont haqida xabar
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: landlordga remont haqida xabar yozing — nima buzildi (boiler, kran, nam), qachondan beri, ta’siri qanday va nimani so‘rayapsiz; oxirida foto yuborishni taklif qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: inglizchada, muloyim ohangda, muammo + sana + so‘rov + dalil, bir daqiqadan qisqa. Keyingi darsda universitetga hujjat topshirishni o‘rganamiz — ariza, motivation letter va intervyular. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: write a repair message to your landlord — what broke, since when, its effect and your request, with a photo offer at the end. Success: English, polite, problem + date + request + evidence, under a minute read aloud. Next lesson: applying to university — forms, motivation letters and interviews. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: landlordga remont haqida xabar — nima buzildi, qachondan, ta’siri, so‘rovingiz + foto taklifi. Mezon: inglizchada, muloyim, muammo + sana + so‘rov + dalil, bir daqiqadan qisqa. Keyingi dars: universitetga hujjat topshirish. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: What does 'pcm' mean in a rental ad?
quiz.why_uz: pcm — per calendar month, oylik to‘lov; pw — per week (haftalik); pw 120 ≈ oyiga 520.

options: The first month's rent, never returned
A refundable security amount, usually one or two months' rent
An agency fee you never see again
The council tax for the year
quiz.why_uz: Depozit — qaytariladigan kafolat summasi, odatda bir-ikki oylik ijara; himoya sxemasida saqlanishi shart.

options: You pay gas, electricity and water separately
The landlord pays all the utility bills
Only the internet is paid for
quiz.why_uz: Bills included — kommunal to‘lovlar ijara narxiga kiritilgan; kiritilmagan bo‘lsa alohida rasmiylashtiring.

quiz.q: Which question is essential at a viewing?
options: 'Is the rent per week or per calendar month?'
'Do you have parking for my bicycle?'
'What time do the neighbours wake up?'
quiz.why_uz: Narx formati (pw yoki pcm) — asosiy savol; pw 120 oyiga ~520 bo‘ladi — chalkashtirmang.

quiz.q: What should you photograph on move-in day?
options: The inventory flaws and the meter readings
quiz.why_uz: Inventory nuqsonlari va hisoblagich ko‘rsatkichlari — chiqish kuni tortishuvlarning oldini oladi.

options: the boiler, the roof and the wiring
quiz.why_uz: Boiler, tom, simlar va trubalar — odatda uy egasi; lampalar va mayda narsalar — sizning.

quiz.q: How do you report a damp wall properly?
options: 'There's damp on the bedroom wall — here are photos.'
quiz.why_uz: Aniq joy + dalil (foto) — eng tez yechim; hissiyotli xabarlar sekinroq javob oladi.

options: The time before your rent increases
How long before the tenancy ends you must give notice
quiz.why_uz: Notice period — shartnoma tugashidan oldin ogohlantirish muddati, ko‘pincha 30 kun.

options: I have 25 years and I rent since 2020.
quiz.why_uz: Since — present perfect bilan: 'I've lived here since March'; uchinchi shaxsga -s ham kerak — 'makes'.

quiz.q: A neighbour plays loud music past midnight. First step?
options: Politely ask them to keep it down, then landlord in writing, then council
quiz.why_uz: Avval muloyim so‘z, keyin yozma xabar uy egasiga, keyin mahalliy idoraga — bosqichma-bosqich.
